correctness.rationale: The cyclic sum is multiplication by 1+x after a choice of shift orientation. Writing n=qh with h odd, the factors x^q−1 and Q=sum_{j=0}^{h−1}x^(jq) are comaximal modulo 2 (Q(1)=1 there), hence modulo 4. The Q factor is invertible for the dynamics and has 4^(n−q) elements, including the one-element factor if h=1. On the other factor, with y=1+x, v₂(binom(q,j))=v₂(q)−v₂(j) gives y^q=2y^(q/2). The monic quotient has basis y^0 through y^(q−1). Its higher powers fold to 2y^(q/2+j) for 0≤j<q/2 and vanish thereafter. The ideal y^t A has q−t free coordinates up to t=q/2, then q−t free and t−q/2 order-two coordinates up to t=q, then only 3q/2−t order-two coordinates up to t=3q/2. Thus the kernel fraction is the reciprocal of the asserted image size, including both transition points and t=0. First differences give the exact counts and the final mass 1/2; y^(3q/2−1)=2y^(q−1) is nonzero. The bounded tests described in VERIFICATION.md and verify.py were inspected, not replayed; the result is proved by the coordinate calculation in RESULT.md §§1–3. The Dular section-number error is bibliographic, not mathematical.

value.rationale: This is a complete transient population census for the standard modular Ducci operator, not just an improvement of a stopping-time bound. It distinguishes the early and late contraction scales, makes the exact frequency of worst-case vectors available, and shows which part of the tuple length matters for the entire normalized law. These facts are useful for the dynamics even when its maximum is known.
